title: Creating a second event instead of returning to the event list after editing lights and intensity
description: When editing an event and selecting lights and intensity, clicking 'Next' incorrectly creates a second event instead of returning the user to the event list.
steps: On the 'What do you want your lights to do?' screen, adjust the 'Intensity' slider.
actual: After selecting lights and intensity and tapping 'Next' on the 'What do you want your lights to do?' screen, the application proceeds to the next step of creating a new event (e.g., 'When do you want the lighting event to occur?'). It does not return the user to the event list as expected.
expected: After selecting lights and intensity and tapping 'Next' on the 'What do you want your lights to do?' screen, the application should close the current event creation/editing screen and return the user to the list of events for the program.
